abstract: Make a ScaleDock website agent-ready: all meaning in the first HTML payload, an explicit per-crawler AI policy in robots.txt, llms.txt, markdown twins served at .md URLs and through Accept: text/markdown negotiation with Vary: Accept (RFC 9110, RFC 7763), one schema.org JSON-LD @graph per page, /.well-known/api-catalog (RFC 9727), WebMCP tools that mirror plain HTTP endpoints, an A2A Agent Card, consistent content rights across aipref, Content Signals, RSL and TDMRep, Web Bot Auth instead of User-Agent trust, sitemaps, security.txt and no hidden instructions to agents. It installs and defers to the matching spec skills; references/checklist.md has a curl check per invariant and references/content-negotiation.md covers the markdown twins.
